note: How a PageSpec may reference tokens. PageSpec nodes carry an optional closed `style` object (slots below) and optional motion durationToken/easingToken. Values must be catalog ids (tokens/llm/token-catalog.json). Category names are the catalog's own `category` values; verify_all checks they resolve.

rawValueRestrictions.color: no hex, rgb(a), hsl(a), color(), oklch() or named colours: TOKEN_RAW_COLOR
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: no px/rem/em/%/vh/vw numbers or clamp()/calc(): TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING

themeBinding.rule: palette.night.* tokens are valid only with theme night, palette.day.* only with theme day (TOKEN_THEME_MISMATCH); semantic color.* tokens resolve per theme and are valid in both.

pageLocalScopes.story.*: tokens of the long-form story page (offline-doctor-consultation.html loads only css/oc-story.css); used by section/component contracts, not assignable through PageSpec style slots
pageLocalScopes.casestudy.*: scope tokens of the chaptered case-study layout; contract-level only
